advice: Abstain. The supplied full512 SME kernel already uses contiguous paired 16-lane FP32 operand loads and contiguous output stores. The general C path also uses contiguous SVE loads and horizontal stores. The ABI provides no alignment guarantee for A, B, or C, so an aligned-only access change is unsupported. I know no distinct useful vector-access experiment within the stated contract.
risks: Changing access grouping could require a new layout or unsupported alignment assumption. Any conversion cost would be timed. The hardware profile confirms SME2 and 16 streaming FP32 lanes, but gives no evidence for a faster access form. No performance effect is established.
